d: Short, amethyst-purple hair with straight bangs and long side-locks is adorned with two large, white ribbon-like bows. Large, round, crimson eyes convey a cheerful, youthful expression on a face with the apparent age of a child. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a navy blue one-piece swimsuit featuring a white rectangular chest panel with the red text "I-19". Visible accessories include a grey submarine-shaped mechanical apparatus positioned behind the back and a large, grey cylindrical torpedo held diagonally across the torso.
